scope.purpose: Bounded diagnosis at the first missing CH-SIMS v2 author-feature range
scope.execution_environment: The bundled Python initially failed before any network call because requests was not installed (ModuleNotFoundError). The three probes then ran with the existing work/research-env Python and requests 2.34.2.
scope.response_close: Each response was closed after reading at most 65536 bytes for an exact 206 range, or at most 4096 bytes otherwise.

local_state.counter_interpretation: Counters are received/completed byte totals, not contiguous coverage. Existing blocks after a hole make the first missing offset lower than the cumulative counter.

historical_8mib_failure.classification: Unresolved. The saved failure does not distinguish a range-ignored full-object response, an HTML/quota fallback, or an intermediary response. It is not a recorded 5xx server error.

probes.label: legacy_public_drive_route
probes.interpretation: The public legacy route redirects to the usercontent download route; no payload or redirect target query was captured.

diagnosis.small_range_at_current_gap: The existing public usercontent URL returns the exact 64 KiB range with matching Last-Modified both with and without If-Range; both bodies have the same SHA-256.
diagnosis.quota_or_html: No quota text or HTML was observed in either successful 64 KiB response. The earlier 8 MiB response body and Content-Type were not recorded, so its type cannot be determined.
diagnosis.range_behavior: Range is not globally ignored: the same starting offset succeeds for 64 KiB. The previously recorded 8 MiB request returned 200 without Content-Range or Last-Modified, but this bounded probe did not reproduce or classify that response.
diagnosis.if_range: A missing or mismatched If-Range validator does not explain the 64 KiB result; both variants return identical data. The historical 8 MiB response remains unexplained.
diagnosis.server_or_gateway: No 5xx occurred in these three requests. The historical 200 may be a server or intermediary fallback, but available headers are insufficient to attribute it.

decision: Do not start the full download from this diagnosis. Small public ranges at the gap are accessible, but the 8 MiB range failure remains unclassified; do not label it as a quota page or a confirmed gateway fault.
